visual_description: A high-fidelity 3D model of a multi-page federal document. The top page features the 'U.S. Department of the Interior - Bureau of Land Management' seal. It contains official-looking fields for 'Permit Number', 'Project Name', and 'Approved Land Description'. There is a blue-ink signature at the bottom and a red 'APPROVED' rubber stamp in the upper margin.

constraints.text_clarity: The BLM seal and the words 'Department of the Interior' must be legible.
constraints.background: The document is clipped to a rugged silver metal clipboard, resting on a dusty Jeep hood.
